items.name: Crucifixo na polia baixa

args.prompt: Personal Pro LOW CABLE CROSSOVER / crucifixo na polia baixa. Match this real standing man's EXACT motion and terminal height: two LOW pulleys at floor, staggered stance, both hands travel UP and INWARD from low open position beside hips, meet directly in front of the CHEST (sternum, BELOW chin), then return DOWN and OUT to same low open starting position. One COMPLETE slow close-and-reopen repetition over four seconds. Arms stay mostly straight with small constant elbow bend, wide shoulder-driven arcs; no biceps curl. CRITICAL: match reference CHEST-HEIGHT finish, hands never reach face, forehead or above head. Torso stays stable, feet planted, shoulders down. Show the entire body, both hands and both low cable anchors, fixed front three-quarter view as reference. Use a DIFFERENT adult with plain GREY T-SHIRT and black shorts, completely unbranded, no writing or symbols on shirt. Clean neutral studio with two low cable towers, blank walls, no posters, logos, watermarks or overlays. Execution only, no setup, talking, cuts, anatomy models. Four second square silent video.
